tools.name: get_gta6_unlock_time
tools.description: When GTA 6 unlocks for a country, city or IANA time zone (PlayStation Store, local midnight 19 Nov 2026). Omit `location` for every region.

tools.name: get_launch_facts
tools.description: GTA 6 release date, platforms, preload, prices (US and Australia), Ultimate Edition early access, PC status, with sources.

tools.name: get_top_clips
tools.description: Top GTA 6 clips on the Sunset Strip leaderboard in the last 24 hours, ranked by player votes (ties: views per hour). Before launch the board ranks trailer reactions, breakdowns and fan trailers.

tools.name: get_gta6_map
tools.description: The confirmed regions of Leonida, the GTA 6 map (Vice City, Leonida Keys and more), with what each is based on.

tools.name: get_top_clippers
tools.description: Players whose GTA 6 clips get the most votes on Sunset Strip (this week or all time), with Daily Job wins, profile links and whether they are available for hire as clippers.

tools.name: get_how_it_works
tools.description: How clips are ranked and checked, the Daily Job and weekly prizes (a free month of Clip Autopilot Pro), invite rewards, player profiles, notifications, and Clip Autopilot plans and pricing.

tools.name: get_daily_challenge
tools.description: Today's GTA 6 clip challenge (the Daily Job) on Sunset Strip, with rules and what's coming up. Jobs start when GTA 6 unlocks on 19 Nov 2026.
